title: carex muricata var. divulsa
intro: Carex muricata var. divulsa, commonly known as Rough sedge, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is a perennial herb that is native to North America and is often found growing in wetlands and along streams. The health benefits of Rough sedge include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of Rough sedge include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antimicrobial activity, as well as the ability to modulate the immune system.
